title: Fine-tuning cribl-decision (Qwen3.5-4B-Base + LoRA) on the Jev C1 technique question

harness.git_rule: this file is committed before the format probe and before any training; a later change is recorded in amendments with its reason and commit

model.quantization: 4-bit NF4, double quantization, bf16 compute; lm_head, vision tower and MTP head not quantized
model.adapter_check: every tensor of adapter_model.safetensors is in the loaded model bit for bit, else stop

question.framing: Jev C1 (jev_judge.py @ f9b452c): state {sentence, source}, flat choice over the case's first 10 catalogue candidates in rank order, labels 'Name (Txxxx)', what = description cut at 400 characters, none_of_these last
question.rotations: 3 option orders (rotation r moves the first r candidates to the end, none stays last), per-option P floored at 0.005, geometric mean, renormalised; pick = argmax (ties in canonical order); none_of_these = no pick
question.readout: options lettered A..; the prompt ends with 'Answer:'; the final hidden state at the last position times the native lm_head rows of the tokens ' A' ' B' .., in float32, softmax over the offered options

data.train: public tram/expert/derived_procedures train splits (CC-BY-4.0); candidates from scripts/benchmark_mapping.py --split train --modes hybrid with TECHNIQUE_EXEMPLARS_ENABLED=false; exact and near (token Jaccard >= 0.9) duplicates of any dev, test or CTI-HAL text dropped; target = the gold options offered (uniform), else none_of_these
data.dev: public tram+expert dev, 659 cases, the candidate lists of data/audits/jev/framing/s1_dev_c1.json (case_set_hash 86910fc4...)
confirmation: CTI-HAL statements, 968 cases, the candidate lists of s3_cti_hal_statements.json (case_set_hash 1a031870...); local evaluation only
public test tram/expert/derived_procedures, 1391 cases, pipeline top-10 from data/audits/refresh_2026-10-07/public_heldout_current.json
refused_for_training_or_selection: ATT&CK procedure sentences and software 'uses' text (indexed or leaky)

lora_shape.target_modules: language-model linear_attn in_proj_qkv/in_proj_z/in_proj_a/in_proj_b/out_proj and self_attn q/k/v/o_proj (Cribl's shape)

fixed.optimizer: AdamW, lr 1e-4, weight decay 0, cosine schedule with 3% linear warmup, gradient clip 1.0
fixed.batch: 1 example per forward, 16 per optimizer step
fixed.checkpoints: every half epoch, each scored on the full dev split (3 orders)
fixed.example_order: candidates shuffled per example (none_of_these last); epochs reshuffled; seed 7
fixed.loss: cross-entropy of the letter softmax against the target distribution

arms.description: Cribl's adapter zero-shot in the chosen format
control: a fresh LoRA of the same shape on the plain base (init=fresh), same data and schedule

references: pipeline rank-1 (the first candidate) on the same cases
Jev C1 stored picks (dev exact 0.514, CTI-HAL exact 0.460, ECE 0.229 / 0.238)

selection.format: highest exact on the first 200 dev cases with Cribl's adapter (probe.py); ties in the order plain, chat, json
selection.checkpoint: per arm, the highest full-dev exact; ties the earlier checkpoint
selection.finalist: the higher full-dev exact of B1 and B2 (ties B1)

confirmation.runs: B0 and the selected checkpoints of B1 and B2, each once on cti_hal and once on test
confirmation.no_retuning: nothing is chosen, refit or rerun because of a confirmation result

success.headline: the finalist on CTI-HAL: exact minus pipeline rank-1 with a paired 95% CI lower bound above 0, and exact >= Jev C1 (0.460)
secondary: public test: exact minus pipeline rank-1 with a paired 95% CI lower bound above 0
CTI-HAL ECE of P(pick) at most Jev C1's (0.238)
B1 above B2 on dev and CTI-HAL (Cribl's adapter helps)

stop_rules: train gold-in-candidates above 0.95 (the exemplar leak is not closed): stop and inspect
more than 1% of a split's cases end in error
adoption: none: an experiment. Any product use (a local judge in place of Jev, the judge_union arm) is a separate decision with the public held-out gate and the attribution naming gate
reporting: every arm and checkpoint (dev curve), single-order and 3-order numbers, per dataset, no-pick counts, calibration, training time and peak GPU memory; reversals reported as measured

amendments.before: the full-dev B0 run and any training
amendments.change: letter logits computed in float32 from the final hidden state and the lm_head rows instead of read from the model's bf16 logits
amendments.reason: bf16 logits are rounded to 1/8 at typical magnitudes, which quantises the probabilities; on 20 dev cases the argmax was identical (20/20) and probabilities moved by at most 0.018
amendments.informed_by: the format probe (first 200 dev cases) ran with bf16 logits; its format choice (chat) is kept

amendments.before: B2's second epoch and any confirmation run
amendments.change: B2 resumes from its 1-epoch checkpoint (step_6308, examples 6309-12616) instead of continuing in one process
amendments.reason: a 4-second system suspend at 09:58 left the B2 process crawling (stuck at optimizer step 520/789 for 2 h, GPU idle, while a fresh process ran at full speed); the owner chose to resume from the last checkpoint
amendments.deviation: the same seed and data/option order are replayed; AdamW moments and dropout draws restart; the 4 examples of the partial accumulation window at the checkpoint are lost. B2's 0.5- and 1-epoch dev scores come from the original process
amendments.informed_by: B1's full dev curve and B2's 0.5/1-epoch dev scores were known; no selection rule changed

amendments.before: B2's second epoch and any confirmation run
amendments.change: B2's second epoch (resumed from step_6308 as in amendment 2) and the public-test confirmations of B0, B1 and B2 run on a rented RunPod GPU (scripts/cribl_finetune/runpod/); CTI-HAL confirmations stay on the laptop
amendments.reason: the laptop capped its GPU at 15 W (P8, 210 MHz) from about 15:30, which slowed training about 25-fold; the owner chose RunPod
amendments.deviation: same code, 4-bit NF4 base, seeds and data order; a different GPU model gives floating-point differences; B0 and B1 test scores also come from the pod, their dev and CTI-HAL scores from the laptop
amendments.data: the upload holds only public CC-BY-4.0 case files (train, dev, test), logs and adapters; CTI-HAL (no licence) is not uploaded
amendments.informed_by: nothing new beyond amendment 2: no confirmation result exists yet

amendments.before: any CTI-HAL confirmation result: B0's CTI-HAL run had started, no CTI-HAL prediction or metric of any arm had been read
amendments.change: a second decision rule, never_abstain: the pick is the most probable of the ten techniques in the stored three-order distribution, never none_of_these, with P(pick) renormalised over the techniques (common.forced_pick); P(none_of_these) is kept as a separate flag. The question, the models and the stored predictions are unchanged; scripts/cribl_finetune/rescore.py applies the rule offline
amendments.reason: under the registered metric a no-pick is always a miss and a pick can only gain, so abstaining can never raise exact or parent-aware; the trained arms said none_of_these on 22-23% of dev cases (training targets were none_of_these for 27.6% of examples, dev's gold-absent share is 16.2%) and on 33% of test
amendments.selection: dev only, the registered rules under the new decision rule: B1 step_9462 (exact 0.687405, tied with step_12616, the earlier wins), B2 step_12616 (0.679818), finalist B1; B0 0.485584; Jev C1 under the same rule 0.520486
amendments.confirmation: CTI-HAL (968 statements, laptop, local only): B0, B1 step_9462 and B2 step_12616 (a new CTI-HAL run; B2 step_6308 is still scored for the registered rule), rescored once with rescore.py

success.headline: the finalist on CTI-HAL under never_abstain: exact minus pipeline rank-1 with a paired 95% CI lower bound above 0, and exact at least Jev C1 as reported (0.460) and Jev C1 under the same rule (from its stored distributions)
secondary: CTI-HAL ECE of the renormalised P(pick) at most Jev C1's under the same rule
B1 above B2 on dev and CTI-HAL under the same rule
diagnostic: AUROC of P(none_of_these) for the cases whose gold is not among the candidates

amendments.test: the public test split was scored with the registered rule before this amendment and that result is part of what motivated it, so test numbers under never_abstain are reported but are not confirmatory; B2 step_12616 is scored on test on the laptop for completeness
amendments.registered_outcome_stands: the registered rule's results stay the registered outcome (test: B1 exact 0.465852 vs pipeline rank-1 0.501078, paired CI [-0.060388, -0.009346], the secondary test criterion failed); never_abstain is reported beside them, never in their place
amendments.informed_by: dev (all checkpoints, offline replay) and the public test result of the registered rule; nothing from CTI-HAL
